###########################################################################
# ES focus queue - core triggers (hand-written).
# es_fq_supported, es_fq_can_<id> and es_fq_vis_<id> are generated by
# tools/focus_queue/generate.py into es_focus_queue_generated_triggers.txt.
###########################################################################

# True when no national focus is in progress.
# The engine applies the static modifier gain_focus while a focus runs; it carries
# the marker modifier es_fq_active_marker = 1 (common/modifiers/00_static_modifiers.txt).
es_fq_idle = {
	set_temp_variable = { es_fq_active_value = modifier@es_fq_active_marker }
	check_variable = { es_fq_active_value < 0.5 }
}
